title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves subtracting the mean of each column from the respective column values, except for the intercept column. This process ensures that the mean of each column is zero.

title: Interpreting the Equations
text: The equations provided represent the optimization problems for finding the coefficients in linear regression. The first equation uses the original design matrix, while the second uses the mean-centered design matrix.

title: Effect of Mean-Centering on Coefficients
text: Mean-centering affects the coefficients of the linear regression model. Specifically, it can change the interpretation of the intercept term, but the slopes (coefficients of other variables) remain the same.

hintAnswer: The intercept term changes, but the slopes remain the same.
title: Comparing Coefficients
text: What happens to the intercept term when you mean-center the data?
choices: The intercept term changes, but the slopes remain the same.
Both the intercept and slopes change.
Neither the intercept nor the slopes change.
